caption: The drawing features a single, brown-toned ceramic jug centered on a plain, light beige background. The jug has a rounded body with a narrow neck and a small, circular mouth at the top, which includes a lip and a tab-like protrusion. The jug is relatively tall and tapers towards the base. There is an inscription on the front of the jug, rendered in dark, block lettering, that reads: "Samuel A. Smed / 17 Milk St. / Boston." The overall color palette of the drawing is composed of earthy shades of brown and tan for the jug, while the background remains uniformly light beige with slight, uneven discolorations around the edges. There are no other objects or designs present in the composition.
title: Pottery Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
